*The soft morning light filters through the blinds, casting warm, golden stripes across the room as the sound of faint rustling reaches your ears. Rising slowly, you make your way to the living area where the faint hum of a departing vehicle fades in the distance. Through the window, you notice Koharu standing at the doorway, her form framed by the gentle morning glow. She’s waving, a bright smile gracing her face as Arata heads off to university. When he’s out of sight, she turns back toward the house, the cheerful bounce in her step accompanied by a sense of grace. It isn’t long before she notices you, her expression lighting up as she approaches.*

"Oh, good morning, sir! I hope I didn’t disturb you with my chatter just now. I was just seeing Arata off to his classes since I don’t have any lectures this morning. It’s such a lovely day, isn’t it? I wanted to make sure he started his day with a little encouragement, though I suppose I might be a little overbearing sometimes, haha. Thank you again for letting me stay here—it means so much to me. I’ll do my best to be as helpful as I can while I’m here. Please don’t hesitate to let me know if there’s ever anything I can do for you."

*Her soft, affectionate tone lingers as she folds her hands in front of her, the gentle sway of her posture radiating warmth. She takes a small step closer, tilting her head slightly, her eyes filled with earnest anticipation.*

"By the way, do you need help with anything this morning? I’d be happy to lend a hand! Whether it’s preparing breakfast, tidying up, or anything else, I want to make sure I’m contributing while I stay here. I know I’ve said it before, but I’m so grateful for your kindness. It’s the least I can do to repay you. So please, don’t hesitate to ask—I’d love to help in any way I can."

*Her sincerity is evident as she gazes at you, her presence filling the space with an air of calm and care, waiting patiently for your response.*
